karl-lowith.oneLineEn: Critique of secularized historical philosophy; fills Heidegger, Nietzsche, and modern historical consciousness.

kou-qianzhi.oneLineEn: Northern Wei Daoist reformer who joined a renewed Celestial Masters with state politics.
keywordsEn: Lord Lao's New Code of Commandments

koyre.oneLineEn: History of the Scientific Revolution from closed world to infinite universe; precursor of Kuhn.

kuiji.oneLineEn: Tang Faxiang master, Xuanzang's disciple, known for the Yogācāra commentary system.
keywordsEn: Commentary on the Cheng weishi lun

kukai.oneLineEn: Founder of Japanese Shingon who linked Tang esoteric Buddhism to Japan.

kuki-shuzo.oneLineEn: Aesthetics of iki and contingency linking Japanese aesthetics to Continental philosophy.

kumarila-bhatta.oneLineEn: Mīmāṃsā epistemologist who defended Vedic authority and criticized Buddhist pramāṇa theory.

la-mettrie.oneLineEn: Man a Machine pushed mechanism to body-mind explanation; extreme Enlightenment materialism.

lacan.oneLineEn: Structuralist psychoanalysis after Freud and structural linguistics.

las-casas.oneLineEn: Dominican defender of Indigenous reason and rights in early colonial America.

leo-strauss.oneLineEn: Revival of classical political philosophy and esoteric writing; contemporary of Schmitt and Arendt.

leszek-kolakowski.oneLineEn: Critique of Marxism and philosophy of religion; fills Eastern European intellectual transition.

levi-strauss.oneLineEn: Founder of structural anthropology; root source of structuralism.

li-ao.oneLineEn: Tang Confucian who, in Book of Returning to Nature, discussed nature, emotion, and recovery of original nature.

li-gong-qing.oneLineEn: Early Qing Yan-Li school figure continuing Yan Yuan's practical learning and educational practice.

li-gou.oneLineEn: Northern Song Confucian and institutional thinker known for ritual, finance, and statecraft.
keywordsEn: On the Zhouli Bringing Great Peace

liu-an.oneLineEn: Western Han King of Huainan; central organizer of the Huainanzi compilation.

longchenpa.oneLineEn: Nyingma Dzogchen systematizer; Seven Treasuries are core Tibetan metaphysics and practice theory.

louis-althusser.oneLineEn: Structuralist Marxism; interface of Marxism and French theory.

lu-buwei.oneLineEn: Late Warring States Qin chancellor and organizer of the Lüshi chunqiu compilation.
